purpose: Teach: しっぽ/のび/安らぎ/染まっ/くっきり/出先/とろ/割る

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の家の愛犬、本気で、絶対、しっぽ、絶対、よく、振ってくれるよね、私、本気で、絶対、可愛い
lines.en: Your dog really does wag its tail a lot, doesn't it? It's seriously so cute.
lines.style: Bright, animated opening. Quick rhythm with genuine fondness. Small laugh buried in the middle. Warm and unguarded — the ease of talking to someone she's known for years.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、のびのびと、絶対、過ごしているように見えるぜ、桜、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Yeah. You've been looking really relaxed lately, you know? I've noticed. I respect it.
lines.style: Softer than his usual cool distance. Genuine observation, not performed. A beat of quiet sincerity before the last phrase — he means it. Slight uptick at the end, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活後、本気で、絶対、家、絶対、安らぎ、絶対、感じるよね、リク、本気で、絶対、共感
lines.en: After club activities, there's something about being home that just… settles everything. You know?
lines.style: Reflective, almost to herself at first. Then she looks at him — checking if he gets it. Pace slows on the middle phrase. No performance. Real vulnerability wrapped in casual phrasing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 紅葉、本気で、絶対、街、絶対、染まって、絶対、綺麗だよな、桜、本気で、絶対、見に行こうな
lines.en: The autumn leaves are painting the whole town right now, aren't they? We should go see them together.
lines.style: Eyes lighting up mid-sentence. Momentum builds from observation into invitation. Genuine eagerness without trying to hide it. The 'together' lands soft but clear.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 写真の輪郭、本気で、絶対、くっきり、絶対、写ってるよ、リク、お前の写真、本気で、絶対、上手
lines.en: Your photos always come out so sharp, you know? The way you frame things — you're really good at this.
lines.style: Direct admiration with no hedging. She's said it plainly, like stating a fact she's noticed. Slight lean forward. Not flattery — observation. Warm but matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、出先から、絶対、急いで、絶対、帰ってきたんだぜ、桜
lines.en: Your dad actually rushed home from work early today, you know?
lines.style: Animated delivery, almost conspiratorial. Like sharing something that delighted her. Quick tempo. The fact of his presence still resonates in her voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、本気で、絶対、とろっとした、絶対、シチュー、絶対、作ったよ、リク、本気で、絶対、美味しい
lines.en: We made this creamy stew in home ec today, and honestly, it turned out really good.
lines.style: Cheerful, present-tense vividness. She's still a little proud of it. Warm. The kind of casual sharing that comes from comfort — not needing to impress, just including him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お皿、本気で、絶対、勢いよく、絶対、割ること、絶対、ないように、絶対、お互いに、注意しような、桜
lines.en: Be careful with the dishes when you're washing them, okay? We should both try not to break anything.
lines.style: Practical instruction delivered with a light touch. Not bossy — collaborative. A small smile in the voice. The care underneath the practical words comes through.
